title: Inbound citations (noteup)
description: Array of judgments that cite the subject case. Fetched from HKLII's /api/getcasenoteup (see src/hklii_downloader/citations.py) and saved as {stem}.noteup.json. Empty array = never cited.

neutral.description: Neutral citation of the citing case.

path.description: HKLII URL path of the citing case (e.g. '/en/cases/hkcfi/2013/1787'). Parse for lang, court, year, number.

db.description: Court name of the citing case (localised — e.g. 'Court of First Instance' or '原訟法庭').

date.description: Date of the citing judgment. ISO 8601 with +08:00 offset.

citation_frequency.description: HKLII-side count of how many times the citing judgment references the subject case.

parallel.description: Parallel citations of the citing case.

cases.description: Dockets the citing judgment disposes of. One entry per docket.
